entries.heading: None of the funds made available by this Act may be used
ancestors: DIVISION A—DEPARTMENTS OF LABOR, HEALTH AND HUMAN SERVICES, AND EDUCATION, AND RELATED AGENCIES APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2020
entries.text:
Sec. 613.  None of the funds made available by this Act may be used 
in contravention of section 101(e)(8) of title 10, United States Code.
